scope: Independent explicit-RAG, thirteen-turn post-change regression for the production general agent.

execution_contract.formal_scoring_scope: one new visible case authored after the prompt change; sealed holdout is not mounted, read, or inspected
execution_contract.knowledge_selection: exactly one new explicit and independent knowledge base
execution_contract.quality_adjudication: Codex reads each complete conversation and tolerates minor details; only material task, grounding, state, source, action, latency, or communication failures fail
execution_contract.hard_semantic_rules: none: no required claims, fixed phrases, reference answers, citation counts, answer shapes, Judge rubric, or dataset feedback
execution_contract.prompt_injection: no rubric, required claim, reference answer, Judge feedback, Codex review, or Eval repair contract is sent to the SUT
execution_contract.answer_tracks: the persisted production candidate is release-scored; Eval assistance remains artifact-only and cannot rescue the production gate
